title: Concept of "Indivisible Security” in Speech on Russia-Ukraine War and Impact on Southeast Asia
what_it_is: Concept of "Indivisible Security” in Speech on Russia-Ukraine War and Impact on Southeast Asia

sections.label: Fundamental principles of international law
sections.summary: Self-determination, sovereignty, territorial integrity and non-recourse to force are fundamental principles of international law.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Self-determination, sovereignty and territorial integrity as well as the non-recourse to the use of force are fundamental principles of international law.

sections.label: Russia's invasion of Ukraine
sections.summary: Russia's invasion of Ukraine violates these principles; Indivisible Security, invoked by Russia, is not a principle of international law or in the UN Charter.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Russia’s invasion of Ukraine violates these basic principles of international law, including self-determination, sovereignty, territorial integrity and the non-recourse to use of force.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Russia has invoked Indivisible Security as among the reasons for the invasion of Ukraine.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: And as I have said, Indivisible Security cannot give grounds for the Russian invasion.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: Indivisible Security is not of the same status as self-determination, sovereignty, or territorial integrity and the non-recourse to use of force.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: And I pointed out that the concept of Indivisible Security, in some form, has been invoked by both Russia and the United States.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: But that does not make it a principle of international law.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: And it is not set out in the UN Charter.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
sentences.text: The result is that Ukraine is the unfortunate victim and its people are paying a terrible price.
